files.shell.css: *{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0}button,input{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,[tabindex]:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #365dc9;outline-offset:2px}.app-shell{height:100dvh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#fff;color:#20232b}.shell-toolbar{flex:none;min-height:56px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:8px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid #d8dce4}.shell-toolbar strong{margin-right:auto}.shell-panes{flex:1;min-height:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:220px minmax(0,1fr)}.shell-panes[data-inspector=true]{grid-template-columns:220px minmax(0,1fr) var(--inspector-width)}.pane{min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;padding:16px}.shell-navigation{border-right:1px solid #d8dce4}.shell-navigation h2{font-size:12px}.shell-navigation button{display:block;width:100%;padding:10px;text-align:left;border:0;background:transparent}.shell-navigation button[aria-current=page]{background:#e7edff;font-weight:700}.shell-inspector{border-left:1px solid #d8dce4}.shell-inspector[hidden]{display:none}.inspector-size{display:grid;gap:8px}.nav-toggle{display:none}.skip-link{position:fixed;top:0;left:8px;transform:translateY(-150%);z-index:10;background:white;padding:8px}.skip-link:focus{transform:translateY(0)}@media(max-width:700px){.nav-toggle{display:block}.shell-panes,.shell-panes[data-inspector=true]{display:flex;flex-direction:column}.shell-workspace{flex:1}.shell-navigation{display:none;flex:0 1 30dvh;border-bottom:1px solid #d8dce4}.shell-navigation[data-open=true]{display:block}.shell-inspector{flex:0 1 35dvh;border-left:0;border-top:1px solid #d8dce4}.inspector-size{display:none}.shell-toolbar{flex-wrap:wrap}}
